Subject: Ambassador code distribution for post-event onboarding

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for sponsoring BrightConf last week. The ambassador cohort had great engagement and we have a small group (≈120) of community leaders who want to offer their networks short-term trial access to Redwood for demos and onboarding sessions.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you provide a batch of single-use promo codes for 30-day trials (we expect ~120) that ambassadors can email to attendees?
- Is there a way to extend redemption windows for folks who sign up during the next 6 weeks? A few ambassadors asked about extended deadlines.

We can host distribution on our side (ambassadors@brightconf.com) but need the codes/format and any campaign labels so our analytics ties back to the BrightConf cohort.

Appreciate any pace/limits you need on issuance. Happy to hop on a call if easier.

Best,

+1 on the buffer. Ops can generate single-use alphanumeric codes and tag them BF-2026-AMB. Draft plan below:

- Quantity: issue 150 single-use codes (120 primary + 30 buffer)
- Trial allocation: 30-day free trial per code
- Redemption window: set code expiry to 6 weeks from issuance (we set absolute expiry date in our code service)
- Tracking: campaign_id BF-2026-AMB; HubSpot UTM mapping to "brightconf_ambassador"; we include a short prefix so partner can parse (BRF-)
- Fraud controls: throttle codes to 10 redemptions/min globally; block multiple signups from same IP after 3 redemptions in 24h; report back daily for 7 days

I'll attach a CSV draft with placeholder codes (NOT the real batch) and include the final output when ops pushes them live. No charge for extended window — treat as partner goodwill for this program.

ETA: Ops can generate and deliver the final CSV by Mon Nov 23 COB PST if we greenlight now.

Marissa Cole
